description.value: Afghan Chopan Restaurant has been serving Richmond and the Lower Mainland since 2001, specializing in traditional Afghan kebabs — lamb shoulder chops, beef tenderloin tekka, and ground-beef shami — all grilled and served with fresh baked naan, chutney, and Afghan-style Pallow. The kitchen uses 100% halal meat and prepares everything from scratch, reflecting the Afghan hospitality the owners describe as central to their culture. It is a sit-down restaurant with a party room and also offers takeout ordering online.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 32m; rack at 59m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the address (1600-8260 Westminster Hwy, Richmond, BC) and phone (604-273-6505) not present in OSM. Takeout is confirmed by an 'Order Now' button and explicit mention of take-away menus; vegetarian options are confirmed by the Vegetarian Combo and Ashak (described as 'Vegeterian Dumplings') on the menu. No evidence of bike parking, Wi-Fi, washroom details, or any cyclist-specific amenity appears on the website or in OSM tags. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Afghan Chopan Restaurant' while the website uses 'Afghan Chopan' on the main pages and 'Afghan Chopan bakery & Diner, Richmond' on subpages.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Afghan Chopan Restaurant' but the website homepage uses 'Afghan Chopan' and subpages use 'Afghan Chopan bakery & Diner, Richmond.'
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags; all contact details sourced exclusively from website and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Afghan restaurant operating since 2001 with a live website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a halal sit-down or takeout meal in Richmond.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a Vegetarian Combo (Bolani, Ashak, one Vegetable Dish) and Ashak is described as 'Vegeterian Dumplings filled with Leeks.' No vegan or GF claims found
